observed_failure_before_design.root_cause: Additive absolute-support fusion allowed four high non-grounding channels to compensate for exactly zero evidence-local grounding.

only_architectural_delta.grounding_gate: When enabled, absolute support is capped by the independently recorded raw grounding channel.
only_architectural_delta.preserved_channels: Absolute support, relative weight, entropy, evidence gap, contradiction, and all raw evidence/query channels remain separately serialized.
only_architectural_delta.legacy_reproducibility: The gate is opt-in; every frozen v2.4.3.20 and earlier config retains additive fusion.

execution_order: development canary 5 if causal gate passes
paired control/HARA Shadow-C20 without between-arm inspection if Smoke-A passes
stop_condition: Continue generic no-training diagnosis and iteration after any development failure. Stop only on the full preregistered HARA gate plus committed safe-stop report, or before the next call would exceed the shared 2000-attempt/2000000-token hard cap.
